summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K announcing the voluntary conversion of its secondary listing to dual-primary listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, effective September 1, 2026. The company remains dual-listed on Nasdaq (BIDU) and HKEX (9888/89888), with shares and ADSs (1 ADS = 8 Class A shares) remaining fungible. No financial terms, share prices, premiums, or board recommendations were disclosed. This is a corporate structural change, not a special-situation event. Watch for ongoing fungibility and regulatory compliance, but there is no arbitrage angle.
